why: The record of the chart's data (R57, AC136, AC137). Written by scripts/chart/build-chart.ts; held to by scripts/chart/check-chart.ts. Never imported by the app: it carries island names, which v1 never shows (D221, AC138), so they live here only for AC138's search.

method.simplification: Douglas–Peucker on each closed ring in local equirectangular metres at the ring's mean latitude; a ring never falls below three points
method.atolls: OSM admin_level=4 relations, named from scripts/chart/atolls.json (today's names, D235)
method.cloud: OSM place=archipelago tagged natural=atoll or natural=reef, outer rings (D246)

crossing.note: Nearest coastline point to nearest coastline point (R59), on the shipped 5 m-simplified, quantised outlines and on OSM's full outlines (AC137, D224)
